name: paseo-factory
description: Verification core for Paseo agents: done-criteria contracts, an append-only JSONL ledger, a gate runner, and traceable reports. Pure Node — zero Paseo imports. The Paseo plugin shell loads this core as a plain module.

scripts.check: npm run sync:plugin-core:check && npm run generate:policies:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:installed: node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && node --test test/installed-artifacts.test.ts test/core-sync.test.ts test/policy-assets.test.ts test/bridge-mcp.test.ts test/ledger-integrity.test.ts
